text:
Ellen: Morning — corpcard pre-auth for my rental car in Lyon posted as €1,250 which blew past my account limit and caused an overdraft on the travel pool. I paid the €35 fuel top-up and a €12 parking fee on my personal card. I have folio + rental agreement pics. Anyone advise next steps?
Carlos: Oof. What's the rental co and folio? Did you reserve under the company's travel policy?
Ellen: Europack Rent a Car, agreement #LR-4478. Booking via Concur under PRJ-502. Attached: https://files.redwood/ellen/lr4478-agreement.pdf and https://img.redwood.internal/ellen/rental-swipe.jpg
Helena: Usually the hold is for security + estimated total. €1,250 sounds like the hold for a van upgrade + deposit. Did they actually charge the whole amount or is it pending?
Ellen: The provider posted a pending charge for €1,250 and it cleared this morning. I had insufficient corpcard remaining so the payment hit our travel pool and created an overdraft hold. I covered the small extras (€47 total) on my personal card.
FinanceBot: Policy reminder: personal expenditures due to corpcard limits may be reimbursed with manager signoff and itemized receipts. See https://wiki.redwood/expenses#card-overdrafts
Carlos: @Helena — can we pre-authorize overspend in emergency cases? For now confirm employee trip approval and we'll fast-track reimbursement for the €47.
Helena: Confirmed trip PRJ-502. @Ellen please upload the rental final invoice + your AMEX receipt to Expensify and tag me. We'll also open a dispute for the full €1,250 with the card provider to investigate whether it should have been an auth-only hold.
Ellen: Uploaded Expensify TXN EXP-550200 with PDFs. Note says: "Corpcard pre-auth turned into charge; personal covered small extras €47." Card last4 3312.
PaymentsBot: Auto-verify: TXN found, attachments: agreement.pdf, invoice.pdf, amex.jpg. Manager match: Carlos = true.
Helena: Approving reimbursement for €47 now. I'll code to GL 6430:employee-travel and schedule ACH. Also opening dispute ticket CARDDISP-931. If dispute succeeds and corpcard is credited, we'll reverse the reimbursement.
FinanceBot: CARDDISP-931 created by Helena at 2024-07-11T08:13Z. Reimbursement scheduled: €47 via payroll adj in next run.
Carlos: Also suggest adding Europack Rent a Car to the known exceptions list; their terminal sometimes posts full deposit as charge. @Procurement please evaluate.
Ellen: Thanks all — saved screenshots and agreement PDF. Appreciate the quick help. :relieved:
Helena: Loop closed for reimbursement. We'll update when dispute resolves. Thanks.
Ellen: Cheers!
